entities.summary:
Acesias was an ancient Greek physician whose age and country are both unknown.

Born in the 4th century BCE, Acesias is believed to have been a student of the physician Hippocrates, who is considered one of the most important figures in the history of medicine.

Acesias made significant contributions to the field of medicine, particularly in the areas of diagnosis and treatment of diseases.

His work had a lasting impact on the development of medicine in the ancient Greek world, and he is still studied by scholars today.

Acesias' legacy extends beyond his own work, as it influenced the development of medical thought and practice in the centuries that followed.

In the words of the ancient Greek physician Galen, 'Acesias was a master of the art of medicine, and his works are still studied by physicians today.'
